### PNG Conversion Note

LinkedIn does not support inline SVG uploads in feed posts. Before publishing,
convert SVG → PNG using any of:

```bash
rsvg-convert -w 1200 -h 627 card-launch.svg > card-launch.png
# or
inkscape card-launch.svg --export-type=png --export-width=1200 --export-height=627
```

SVGs are served at the web URL for og:image (browser rendering) and social
preview cards (Twitter/LinkedIn unfurling). Direct uploads require PNG.

## 7. Publication Execution Runbook

### Pre-Publication Checklist (per post)

1. Convert SVG → PNG if LinkedIn post with visual card
2. Verify UTM parameters are appended to all outbound links
3. Check hashtags match platform-specific guidelines (SP-12-703 §1)
4. Confirm posting time (UTC) matches optimal engagement window
5. Verify canonical URL set for Dev.to articles (point to repo docs)
